title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Idhu Enna Maayam
desc: Arun creates a match making app that involves his theatre skills. But when a rich man requests to set him up with Arun's ex-girlfriend, Arun has second thoughts about helping him.

title: Nannbenda
desc: When Sathya's girlfriend is threatened to be killed by a goon, he and his friend Siva decide to beat him up. But when the goon dies in an accident, the two friends are accused of murder.

title: Friends
desc: Three friends, who are extremely close, face many complications after several people plot to break them apart by spreading lies and creating misunderstandings among them.

title: Jigarthanda Double X
desc: In the 1970s, a convict who aspires to be a policeman embarks on an undercover mission as a film-maker to kill a gangster who wants to launch himself as an actor.

title: Thanga Magan
desc: Tamizh investigates the true reasons behind his father's suicide. His investigation exposes buried secrets, leading him to confront betrayal and fight for justice.
